title: Grateful Dead Live at Saenger Performing Arts Center on 1982-09-09
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B) > Dat (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/48k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac1648; the original version had a duplicate "Space" ("Drums > Space" were 1 track, followed by "Space" again)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording suffers from pitch‑speed issues and a brief dropout, yet the show shines with a monster Wheel, an inspired Estimated Prophet, and a solid Good Lovin'.
ai_review.review: The tape is a soundboard source that runs noticeably fast and needs several pitch corrections; Space even has a short dropout. Musically the second set redeems the uneven first, delivering a smoking Wheel, a hot Estimated Prophet jam, and an on‑the‑button Good Lovin', while early songs suffer from a muffed Mississippi Half‑Step and an abrupt Althea exit.

ai_rating.rationale: The performance is average to good (standout second set) but the recording has serious pitch and balance problems, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Runs ~3‑4% fast in many sections; requires multiple pitch adjustments. Brief dropout at start of Space, overall balance issues, and occasional muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set uneven with a premature Althea exit; second set builds momentum, delivering strong jams and a memorable encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Muffs his place in Mississippi Half‑Step, adds extra parts on Franklin's Tower, drops a solo later, and ends up covering rhythm after Althea.
band_member_comments.Bob: Leaves stage during Althea due to equipment problems, interrupting the song.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent steps forward after Althea, providing both rhythm figures and lead lines.
